glossary.QT interval: A part of the heartbeat seen on an ECG. If it gets too long, a dangerous irregular heartbeat can happen.
glossary.QT prolongation: Lengthening of the QT interval on an ECG, which raises the risk of a dangerous irregular heartbeat.
glossary.serotonin syndrome: A reaction to too much serotonin: shaking, sweating, fever, fast heartbeat and confusion. It can be serious.
glossary.NSAID: A group of pain and swelling medicines such as ibuprofen, diclofenac and aspirin.
glossary.contraindicated: Listed as not to be used together, or not to be used in this situation.
glossary.hyperkalaemia: Too much potassium in the blood, which can affect the heart.
glossary.CNS: The brain and spinal cord (central nervous system).

about.title: About PrescripTrace
about.what: PrescripTrace checks a list of medicines for known interactions, duplicated ingredients and official recall or quality alerts. Every warning shows where it came from.
about.notWhat: It does not detect fake medicines. It matches medicines against official alert lists and gives you a checklist for inspecting the pack.
about.privacy: The medicine list stays in this browser tab only and is cleared when you close it. No patient names or ID numbers are asked for or stored.
about.disclaimer: Decision support only, not a diagnosis or prescription. Absence of a warning is not proof of safety. Consider confirming with the prescriber.

scan.title: Scan a prescription

tips.light: Use good light and avoid shadows.
tips.frame: Fit the whole page in the photo.

scan.privacy: The photo is read on the server and is not stored. No names are kept.
scan.offDevice: This server uses an external AI service to read photos, so your photo is sent outside this system.

warnings.low_contrast: The photo is faint or dark. Try better light.
warnings.handwriting_or_blur: This looks handwritten or blurry. Handwriting is often misread, so check every line carefully.
warnings.no_medicines_found: No medicine names were recognised. You can add lines below or type them.

offline.title: Use without internet
offline.what: Save the interaction data on this phone so you can check medicines without a connection.
offline.limits: Offline checks are partial: they cover serious and moderate interactions, duplicates and the combination rules. Recall and quality alerts, label notes, patient details (pregnancy, kidney, liver, age), minor interactions and reading photos need the internet.
